title: Deeper/broader open-source implementation-family and comparator selection review
mode: Primary project documentation/source review; research-only plan consolidation
scope: Re-audit open-source DWG/DXF codec, projection, kernel, and consumer routes by operation, version, and implementation lineage.
Identify useful source-distinct comparison routes and their limits for the existing PAR-07/S8 owners.
Reduce optional peer work by selecting at most one route for an exact unresolved question at a composed checkpoint.

method.kind: Read-only review of current primary project documentation, source, and issue pages
method.limitations: Mutable project documentation and issue reports are route-scoping evidence only. No external route was executed; no peer claim, local defect, native acceptance, or semantic support was independently qualified by this pass.

sources.observed: DWG read/write and conversion routes have direction/version-specific boundaries. R2007 writing is unavailable in published documentation; AcDsPrototype/SAB extraction remains an explicit caveat in project materials, and issue #1411 is a build-specific carrier-loss report.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Project declaration and a report for a specific peer version, not local reproduction, universal peer behavior, or 3D semantic qualification.

sources.observed: The public matrix separates DXF/DWG reader and writer by version and does not list an AC1021 DWG writer.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A mutable project capability matrix; entity/object semantics and final document membership still require pinned operation-specific evidence.

sources.observed: Mutable ACadRust source declares 0.6.5 while the published docs/crate remain 0.5.5. Open issues #133/#134 provide owner-orphan and bounded auxiliary-record adversarial prompts; maintainer candidate commits have no public private-corpus retest. OpenCADStudio is an application using an ACadRust-derived codec fork and a separately described early kernel.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Source/package mismatch, peer reports, and self-described application/kernel capabilities are not verified fixes, independent parser votes, or complete B-rep evidence.

sources.observed: A separately implemented direct DWG reader documents a bounded modern 2D entity cohort, a native AC1015 writer subset, and ezdxf-backed DXF output.
sources.evidenceCeiling: An optional read-side comparator for overlapping entity/version routes only; it is not a modern DWG writer or ACIS/AcDs semantic oracle.

sources.observed: The pre-alpha reader publishes decoded/skipped/errored counts with small per-version sample denominators and explicitly documents missing entity coverage, no DXF parser, and no R14/R2007 writer.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Useful only for an exact container or disposition question; aggregate success percentages and experimental writer output do not establish interoperability.

sources.observed: The project documents ASCII/Binary DXF read/write through R2018 and third-party content retention; its unknown tag-storage object is not generally copyable or transformable.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Strict DXF syntax and supported in-place preservation only; not transformed graph preservation, DWG parsing, or ACIS semantics.

sources.observed: The DXF driver projects into OGR geometry/features, tessellates some curves, can transform block/entity structure, supports Binary DXF from GDAL 3.12, and can expose AC1027+ raw ASM plus transform without constructing solid geometry.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Exact-version projection or raw-carrier observation only; not full structural round trip, DWG AcDs association, or B-rep validation.

sources.observed: FreeCAD DWG import is a converter-to-DXF then selected-importer route with importer-specific coverage; LibreCAD_3 is a downstream libdxfrw consumer with a read-only, opt-in DWG policy.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Consumer-route qualification only; neither is an independent codec implementation or stock ACIS semantic reader.

assessment.planEffect: Consolidate a route-selection matrix and cap optional comparisons at one source/artifact-pinned route per unresolved question at an existing composed checkpoint.
